title: Manoeuvre question
description: A choice question whose options are burns, shown as cards with a diagram of the thrust direction. A fork of the quiz block: same scoring, feedback, saved state and SCORM records.
instructions: Use for questions whose options are manoeuvres. Give each option a diagram (images/burn-<direction>.svg, generated by generators/figures.mjs). The diagram shows what the option says (the thrust direction), never the outcome. Two to four options.

figure.description: Diagram of the burn (decorative: the option text says it).

props.stem: You fly **50 km behind** the client satellite. Which first burn closes the gap?
